## Houston 1.0.16

### What's new

- Better reading of the PDF and Word files you attach.
- Files you attach in a task's chat go to that task's AI employee.
- Token usage optimizations, so your AI plan lasts longer.
- Security and performance updates.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
